summary.text: Dawn Wolf is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 107 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Dawn Wolf lives in Ottawa County, Kansas, and her career experience includes working in public education.
Wolf took office representing Kansas House District 107 on January 13, 2025, succeeding Susan L. Concannon.
In the 2025–2026 session she was assigned to the House Education Committee, the House Local Government Committee and the Taxation Committee.
